label: Examine the vault and the display case
description: Photograph the vault, the case and the replica; seize the bird.
narration: The vault is photographed and the singing fake is lifted from its case.

label: Pull the vault access log
description: Export the vault controller's records for the week.
narration: The vault controller gives up a week of door events.

label: Seize the corridor CCTV
description: Image the DVR and review the vault corridor camera.
narration: The DVR is imaged. The corridor camera has a hole on Monday night.

label: Obtain the restoration work order
description: Ask the registrar for the paperwork on the bird's restoration.
narration: The registrar produces the restoration file.

label: Obtain the insurance policy
description: Get the Nightingale's policy from the insurer.
narration: The insurer sends over the policy.

label: Seize the night guard's logbook
narration: The logbook is taken from the desk and its pages numbered.

label: Requisition Lucien Ravel's bank statements
description: Production order for the owner's personal accounts.
narration: Ravel's bank answers the production order.

label: Requisition Irene Vance's studio accounts
description: Production order for the restorer's business accounts.
narration: The studio's accountant hands over the books.

label: Trace freight shipments from the studio
description: Ask the local freight depots about consignments from the studio this week.
narration: Halden Freight finds a crate booked on Tuesday morning.

label: Search Irene Vance's studio
description: Search the restorer's studio and workbench. This is a private space.
narration: In a locked cabinet behind the workbench there is a two-part silicone mould.

label: Take the diagnostic tablet Felix offers
description: Felix has explained his night visit; accept and image his service tablet.
narration: Felix Dorn hands over his tablet as if it were a hostage.

label: Search Felix Dorn's van
description: Search the security consultant's work van. This is a private space.
narration: Under the passenger seat of Dorn's van there is a service tablet.

label: Check Lucien Ravel's Wednesday alibi
description: Ask the Lantern Club and the taxi firms about Ravel's movements.
narration: The Lantern Club, with visible reluctance, opens its members' book.

label: Obtain Irene Vance's phone records
description: Request call data for the restorer's phone.
narration: The network operator returns a week of call records.
